flora: Algal bloom (swirling cloud of vibrant emerald and teal)
Dried algal mat (leathery, cracked, pale green/grey texture)
Water's edge (transition from liquid bloom to salt-crusted silt)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; liquid elements have a soft, 'gel-like' appealing translucency; dried mats appear satisfyingly tactile and brittle; high-saturation colors.

visual_logic.composition: A tiled layout: Top-Left: a swirling overhead view of a liquid bloom; Top-Right: a close-up of a dried, cracked algal mat on the playa surface; Bottom-Left: a stylized 'magnified' circle showing glowing green cellular spheres; Bottom-Right: the interface where teal water meets orange silt.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of wet, saturated silt and dry, salt-crust mineral deposits.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright diffused light, with a slight internal glow applied to the liquid algae for a clean, cinematic look.
